name: dsh-vivy-console
description: Vivy Studio first-party console: 总控台 (main console) — one-click start/stop/restart of the unified development loop, backend status + frontend status side by side, and one unified log timeline. Backend is a pure-API vivy build (vivy_headless, no embedded frontend); frontend is the DEV dev server (Vite pnpm dev, :3015). Development loop only — Studio distribution stays on vivy-sdk/vivy-studio.exe CLI
